rules: Use Fraunces (or Playfair Display) for all headings to give a distinctive, warm, craft-brew editorial feel.
Use Manrope for body text and UI elements to ensure modern readability.
Headings (text-3xl+) MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Do not use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Body text should have leading-relaxed for high readability.

layouts.navigation: Sticky header with backdrop-blur-xl and bg-white/70 glassmorphism. Include Custom SVG logo mark (beer-foam/neural-node hybrid), navigation links, and a primary CTA 'Join Waitlist'. Must not be fully transparent.
layouts.hero: Kinetic hero section with generous padding (py-32). Use Framer Motion for line-by-line masked text reveals. Integrate a parallax hero visual alongside or beneath the text. Include a distinctive 'Coming soon to Delhi NCR & Hyderabad' badge.
layouts.concept_strip: Horizontal strip mixing 3 real photography images (lecture, drinks, networking) with large typographic facts. Overlap elements slightly to break the grid.
layouts.timeline: Horizontal-scroll timeline mapping the event evening: 'Doors & drink' -> 'Talk' -> 'Q&A' -> 'AI Summary in inbox' -> 'Networking'. Use a connecting SVG line.
layouts.bento_grid: Asymmetrical 'Tetris' feature bento grid (col-span-full, col-span-2, etc.) covering: AI categories, curriculum builder, event summaries, forums, moderated circles, explore feed, leaderboard, and courses. Avoid equal squares.
layouts.marquee: Slow editorial marquee using react-fast-marquee showing AI topics and cities. Use the heading font, large outline or pale text.
layouts.city_cards: Launch city cards for Delhi NCR and Hyderabad featuring architecture shots + an abstract 'next-cities' teaser card. Use image hover zoom effects.
layouts.waitlist: Footer-area waitlist CTA with high contrast (maybe dark amber background). Email input + role selection dropdown (Corporate, Speaker, Member).

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or crisp rectangular with slight radius. Must have hover animations (slight scale or shadow lift). Primary color is Amber (#D97706).
components.cards: Subtle borders (border-stone-200), minimal shadows unless hovered. Solid white background. Do not overuse cards; try borderless text-heavy sections for variety.
components.forms: Use Shadcn components for Select and Input. Customize to remove the default 'Vercel-look' (e.g., warmer focus rings, softer borders).

motion: Lenis smooth scrolling is MANDATORY for the premium feel.
Framer Motion for staggered text reveals in the hero and bento grid.
Parallax on the hero image (use framer-motion useScroll).
Micro-interactions on hover (buttons, city cards, bento items).
visual_enhancers.icons: Use exclusively lucide-react. NO EMOJIS anywhere.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a very subtle noise overlay (SVG filter or CSS pattern) to kill the 'digital flatness' and enforce the 'brew' texture.

hero_parallax.description: Warm modern bar crowd - use for parallax hero background or adjacent visual with a light/amber overlay.

concept_drinks.description: Toasting beers for the 'pint on us' concept.

city_delhi.description: Delhi NCR architecture for the launch city card.

city_hyderabad.description: Hyderabad Charminar for the launch city card.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the custom SVG logo exactly as described: an interplay between a beer-foam shape and neural-node network points.
Strictly apply a Mobile First approach (390px base).
Implement Lenis for momentum scrolling (import ReactLenis).
Do not use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical alignments, dynamic grid spans, and generous padding (p-8 to p-32).
Include data-testid attributes for interactive elements (buttons, inputs, waitlist form submit).
Construct the UI in standard React (+ JS, not TSX) files within the provided scaffolding.
Form submission for the waitlist must simulate success or hit a mock backend endpoint, capturing Email + Role.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Never use AI assistant emojis (🤖, 💡, 🧠). Use clean lucide-react SVGs.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom selection states, and proper z-index layering separate good from extraordinary.
Ensure contrast rules are strictly met, especially when placing text over the warm amber elements or images.
